screens.accessibility: Preserve H1, semantic release table, explicit labels, field-associated errors, visible focus, flash status, and live-region announcements.
screens.content_constraints: Release titles up to 200 characters and versions up to 80 characters must wrap without resizing tables or hiding controls.
screens.responsive_behavior: Use a two-column workspace above 640px and a single-column sequence at mobile width; no element may exceed the viewport.

screens.accessibility: Gate and risk controls must keep allowed action buttons reachable by keyboard and expose status text independent of color.
screens.content_constraints: Gate names up to 120 characters and risk descriptions up to 500 characters must wrap inside cards and preserve action placement.
screens.responsive_behavior: Gate and risk panels may sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile while preserving selected-release context.

screens.accessibility: Audit timeline entries must expose prior status, new status, entity, action, and timestamp in reading order.
screens.content_constraints: Audit history must remain readable for at least seven ordered events and preserve long actor or action details with wrapping.
screens.responsive_behavior: The audit section stays full width in the detail column on desktop and follows gate/risk work on mobile.
